provenance.rule: SHA-256 of every file that produces or shapes this record, by path relative to benchmark/. The candidate is bound by coefficients_sha256. A change to any of them makes the record stale until validate_kernel.py --regenerate --reason TEXT rewrites it (PREREGISTRATION.md Amendment 3).

normal_tail_study/PREREGISTRATION.md.role: design and configuration, with its amendments

amendments: Amendment 1: A2 (strict positivity) replaced by A2' (cancellation factor <= 1 + 2^-20 on set A), recorded after the derivation run failed A2 only

Amendment 2 (#78): P2 conditioning restated as kappa = |z| phi(z) / F for survival and cumulative alike, and kappa * delta as phi(z) * eta / F with eta = 2^-52 |z| (Normal) or 2^-52 (|z| + |ln x| / sigma) (Lognormal), defined at z = 0; recorded after A6 was observed, nothing refitted, no threshold changed

Amendment 3 (#79): fit convergence defined (16-point alternation, levelling ratio <= 0.01 against the de la Vallee Poussin bound; CAP_EXHAUSTED and NOT_CONVERGED fail) and results bound to the SHA-256 of their generator, models, validator, design and inputs; recorded after the fit and A6 were observed, nothing refitted, no threshold changed

holdout_exposure.note: Added on 2026-11-03 (#80) from the acceptance.A6 block committed in #75, without evaluating the holdout again. The committed record reports one evaluation (A6.evaluated_once). The validator of that commit could neither prevent nor detect a repeat, so the count is the record's own report, not an enforced guarantee; from #80 on, the validator enforces it. started_utc is the generated_utc of the recorded run, which wrote V immediately before evaluating H. The candidate, design and holdout identities are those of the files committed with the record, unchanged since.

regenerations.reason: #78: Amendment 2 restates the P2 conditioning term as kappa = |z| phi / F for both signs and kappa * delta as phi(z) * eta / F, with eta the absolute error bound of the computed z, defined at the Lognormal centre (x = 1, mu = 0); records z, kappa and eta per P2 row; no refit, no threshold change

#79: Amendment 3 defines fit convergence (16-point alternation, levelling ratio <= 0.01 against the de la Vallee Poussin bound; CAP_EXHAUSTED and NOT_CONVERGED fail) and binds the record to the SHA-256 of its generator, models, validator, design and inputs; the frozen fit was rerun and reproduced kernel_coefficients.json byte for byte (CONVERGED); no refit, no threshold change
